newsitem.title: USA: Maseca Q3 net profit rises.
newsitem.headline: Maseca Q3 net profit rises.

text.p: Grupo Industrial Maseca SA de CV said on Friday its net profit for the third quarter of 1996 was 174 million, up from 138 million in the same period of 1995.
The Mexican company said in a statement sales for the third quarter were 1.64 billion pesos, up from 1.03 billion in the same period the year before.
The gross profit for the quarter was 377 million pesos against 307 million for the same period in 1995.
The company reported nine-month results on Thursday, including earnings per share of 0.69 peso against 0.51 for the same period in 1995.
It reported revenues of 4.56 billion pesos against 2.98 billion for the same period the year before and operating earnings of 660.5 million pesos against 474.5 million in the same period in 1995.
Net results were 445.4 million pesos in the January-to-September period against 362.9 million the year before.
